HORIZON EUROPE — INNOVATION ACTION (IA)
Topic: HORIZON-CL5-2026-INDUSTRY-ONLY-01

Scope:
Industry-led pilots for circular-economy battery recycling at TRL 7-9.
The action is restricted to commercial actors that can demonstrate
existing manufacturing capacity and immediate market deployment plans.

Eligibility:
- Open exclusively to FOR-PROFIT industrial entities (SMEs and large
  enterprises). Universities, research organisations, and public bodies
  are NOT eligible as beneficiaries; they may participate only as
  associated partners without funding.
- The consortium must include at least 4 independent industrial entities
  from at least 4 different EU MS / AC.

Page Limit: 30 pages total for Part B.

Submission language: English.

Deadline: 2026-11-20.

Indicative budget per project: EUR 10 million.
